description: Report whether a path is indexed and which revision (doc_hash) it holds. Use before writing to avoid duplicate work, and after writing to confirm completion.
name: kb_document_status

description: Store one markdown document in the knowledge tree and index it. `path` is the document's stable identity, e.g. "tree/docs/kagent/agent-delegation.md"; writing the same path again replaces the previous revision. Frontmatter (title, source_url, source_type, tags) is added if absent for agent writes. Returns a receipt: status "ingested"|"unchanged"|"empty" plus path, doc_hash and chunks. Re-sending identical content is a no-op, so retries are safe.

force.description: Re-embed even if the body is unchanged.
force.title: Force

source_type.description: Must be one of the agent-allowed source types.
source_type.title: Source Type

source_url.description: http(s) page the content came from.
source_url.title: Source Url

name: kb_store_document
